title: Voltage Profile Plot (matplotlib)
description: Upload a bus-results CSV (the kind exported from the power-flow lab) and get a publication-ready PNG + PDF voltage-profile chart with G-Code limit bands. Runs python + matplotlib in your browser via Pyodide.

inputs.name: bus-results.csv
inputs.description: CSV with at least BusID and Vmag_pu columns (extra columns are ignored).

script:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('/input/bus-results.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))

ax.axhspan(0.95, 1.05, color='#22c55e', alpha=0.10, label='Normal (0.95–1.05 pu)')
ax.axhline(0.95, color='#f97316', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axhline(1.05, color='#f97316', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
ax.axhline(0.90, color='#ef4444', linestyle=':',  linewidth=0.8)
ax.axhline(1.10, color='#ef4444', linestyle=':',  linewidth=0.8)

def colour(v):
    if v < 0.90 or v > 1.10: return '#ef4444'
    if v < 0.95 or v > 1.05: return '#f97316'
    return '#2563eb'

x = df['BusID'] if 'BusID' in df.columns else range(1, len(df) + 1)
ax.bar(x, df['Vmag_pu'],
       color=[colour(v) for v in df['Vmag_pu']],
       edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.4)

ax.axhline(1.00, color='gray', linestyle='-', linewidth=0.6)
ax.set_ylim(0.85, 1.15)
ax.set_xlabel('Bus number')
ax.set_ylabel('Voltage magnitude (pu)')
ax.set_title(f"Bus voltage profile — {params['title_suffix']}")
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/output/voltage-profile.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.savefig('/output/voltage-profile.pdf')
print(f'Wrote PNG + PDF for {len(df)} buses')

examples.label: Healthy 8-bus profile
examples.description: All voltages between 0.96 and 1.04 pu — every bar inside the green band.

examples.label: N-1 outage — voltages low
examples.description: Worst-case N-1 contingency drives buses 6–8 below 0.95 pu — orange/red bars appear.

examples.label: Winter peak — high gen
examples.description: Heavy generation pushes the source-end buses above 1.05 pu (orange).
